P-MEN-01.summary: A planned workforce of 21 specialised AI agents, run on IT7Q's own systems, that handles much of the back office.

sections.heading: Agents at work
paragraphs: A planned team of 21 agents, including:
items: Oracle: watches the health of IT7Q's systems
A security agent that watches for attacks and blocks repeat offenders
Marianna (live): checks the inbox every 10 minutes, sorts and summarises mail, and sends a 7 am digest
Constance: prepares social media posts with matching images
FORTUNA: keeps watch on investments (see its own card)

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Partly live: Marianna runs every day
Every agent reports into its own Nexus channel

P-MEN-02.summary: The memory layer that lets IT7Q's AI remember people and context properly, designed in-house from a clean sheet.

sections.heading: Design
items: Remembers what was said between each pair of people or agents, not one big pile
Four levels of observation, each linked back to its source
A tiered question-and-answer interface for other systems
A nightly consolidation pass that tidies and strengthens memories
Text understanding runs locally; a commercial AI model is used for summarising

sections.heading: Why it matters
items: The keystone for the Support Portal's AI layer, agent memory, CUSTOS and JANUS

P-MEN-03.summary: A website-building agent: a client answers a few questions, and Neo takes them from proposal to a live site.

sections.heading: Flow
items: Online intake form
Automatic proposal
Site deployed from a template
Customised and reviewed
Launched

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Part of the Persephone agent workforce; intake form running

P-MEN-04.summary: An AI agent that watches investment markets and reports back in plain English. It currently trades on paper only (no real money).

sections.heading: How it works
items: Watches Australian and US markets
Runs morning and evening checks
Reports into its own Nexus channel

sections.heading: Where it's at
items: Paper trading only

P-MEN-05.summary: White-label AI chat assistants for small businesses: 24/7 customer support without extra staff.

sections.heading: What clients get
items: An assistant customised to the business's brand, FAQs and services
Deployed on the business's website or as a standalone assistant
Customer support around the clock, without extra staff
Runs on IT7Q's own AI infrastructure, with no third-party AI subscriptions

sections.heading: Pricing and timing
items: Indicative: $500 setup, then $49–$149 a month
1–2 weeks to deploy
